how_to_apply: Download the application form from the ILBS website: https://www.ilbs.in/images/media/faculty-form.pdf.
Fill in the form and pay the application fee by electronic transfer, as described in the form.
Send the duly filled form by email to [email protected] latest by 23 November 2026.
Attach photocopies of degree, certificate, diploma, testimonials and experience certificates.
Also submit a copy of a recent passport size photo, the date-of-birth entry from the matriculation certificate or SSLC, and attested copies of the degree certificate or diploma.
The notice names the Institute of Liver & Biliary Sciences, D – 1, Vasant Kunj, Delhi – 110070 as the institute inviting the applications; the applications themselves are to go by email.

The fee is non-refundable. It is paid by electronic transfer to Account No. 50100143852078, RTGS/NEFT IFSC - HDFC0000273, HDFC Bank, Branch: Site No. 2, OCF Pocket, Sector - C, Vasant Kunj, New Delhi - 110070. The application form gives the payment details.

All applications received will be screened by the Screening Committee as per the Recruitment Rule of the post. Shortlisted candidates will be called for interview. The Institute reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates called for interview to a reasonable limit, on the basis of qualification and experience higher than the minimum prescribed in the advertisement and other academic achievements. The interview date and venue are not specified in the notice.
important_instructions: The vacancy is subject to change at any time, and the Institute reserves the right whether or not to fill any post. No appeal will be entertained or accepted. A vacancy may be removed from the website once the post is filled; a post falling vacant may also be added at the discretion of ILBS. The Institute reserves the right to reject any or all applications without assigning any reason. No correspondence will be entertained about the conduct of the interview or the reasons for not being called for interview. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification. In case of any dispute, the jurisdiction of court will be Delhi/New Delhi only. For queries, candidates may call the HR department on 011-46300000, Ex: 23234 and 23233.

content_sections.heading: About ILBS
content_sections.text: ILBS describes itself as an autonomous super-specialty Institute of excellence under GNCT of Delhi and a Deemed-to-be-University by the UGC. Its stated vision is to be a global leader by becoming a beacon of patient care, teaching and research in liver, gall bladder and pancreatobiliary diseases. The Institute is at D – 1, Vasant Kunj, Delhi – 110070.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice lists 10 vacancies in total across 8 posts. The Institute states that the vacancy is subject to change at any time and that it reserves the right whether or not to fill any post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The pay package is based on the 7th CPC at the pay level applicable for the Institute. All eight posts are on "Contract Basis" for a period of one year. Either side can end the contract by giving the other party not less than three months' notice in writing, or salary in lieu of the notice period. The date of joining and other conditions will be as per the HR policy of the Institute.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in ILBS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 10 vacancies across 8 posts. Consultant (Anaesthesia) Grade IV has 3 (2 UR, 1 OBC) and each of the other seven posts has 1 UR vacancy.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for ILBS faculty posts?
faq.answer: The last date is 23 November 2026. The form must be sent by email to [email protected] latest by that date.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for ILBS faculty and consultant posts?
faq.answer: The age limit is 50 years for seven posts and 55 years for Consultant (Data Scientist – AI Health) Grade III. The upper limit is relaxable by 5 years for SC/ST and 3 years for OBC.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for ILBS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 590/- (Rs. 500/- + 18% GST), and Rs. 118/- for SC/ST, EWS and Ex-Serviceman candidates. Persons with disabilities pay no fee, and the fee is non-refundable.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for the ILBS faculty posts?
faq.answer: Download the form from the ILBS website, fill it in and email it to [email protected] with photocopies of degree, diploma and experience certificates, a passport size photo copy and the date-of-birth proof, before 23 November 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for ILBS Assistant Professor and Consultant posts?
faq.answer: The remuneration is pre-revised PB - IV with grade pay 8700 under the 7th CPC, and grade pay 9500 for Consultant (Data Scientist – AI Health) Grade III.

faq.question: Q7. Is the ILBS job permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The appointment is on contract basis for one year. Either side can end it with not less than three months' written notice, or salary in lieu of notice.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected by ILBS?
faq.answer: The Screening Committee screens all applications as per the Recruitment Rule of the post, and shortlisted candidates are called for interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is there a fee exemption for persons with disabilities?
faq.answer: Yes, no application fee is charged to persons with disabilities. Those with not less than 40% of the relevant disability alone get the PWD reservation benefit.

faq.question: Q10. Is computer knowledge required for ILBS posts?
faq.answer: Yes, working knowledge of Computer is essential for all the posts.
